title: Fix rejected drain PR #122 (agent/drain/OS-curriculum-v2-conformance-33)
description:
Drain PR #122 (branch `agent/drain/OS-curriculum-v2-conformance-33`) was NOT merged by pr-auto-review (llm-rejected).
Repair it ON THE EXISTING BRANCH — do NOT create a new branch or a second PR:
1. `git fetch origin agent/drain/OS-curriculum-v2-conformance-33 && git checkout agent/drain/OS-curriculum-v2-conformance-33`
2. Address EVERY reason below.
3. Run `npm test` until green.
4. Commit and `git push origin agent/drain/OS-curriculum-v2-conformance-33` — the reviewer re-reviews at the new SHA.

## Rejection reasons (verbatim)
- Test file was completely rewritten instead of adding new tests
- Removed all existing test functionality for schema validation and capture logic
- Scope creep: task only required adding screening step, not rewriting entire test suite
- Tests no longer validate the core inbox capture functionality
